originalNotes: Data are accurate as of July 21, 2026.
Note1: Parking ticket data reflects the information available in the system at the time of retrieval. As records are continuously updated, recent tickets may not appear immediately.
Note2: The data includes parking violations only for violations in BUS/TAXI STOP, BIKE LANE And BUS LANE.
Request: P197426 Alex Cannon -"List of violations / tickets written for illegal parking in BIKE LANE, BUS LANE, or BUS STOP from 2022 to PRESENT with dates and locations"

illegalParking.note: Conventional tickets cover Chicago citywide. Smart Streets covers its pilot area and changing camera coverage. Bus/taxi/carriage stand tickets are broader than Smart Streets bus-stop tickets. This comparison does not measure a reduction in illegal parking, enforcement effectiveness, or an equivalent geographic exposure. The conventional extract supplies no fine or payment amounts; its locations are masked to blocks and some are missing.

sources.note: Violations are from a Chicago Department of Finance FOIA export obtained by Alex Cannon.

methodology.dataRange: Violations are included when they appear in the FOIA extract through 2026-09-12.
methodology.fineAmounts: Listed fines sum the FOIA Fine Level 1 values. Fine-bearing violations are records where Fine Level 1 is greater than zero; listed fines do not measure payment, collection, or adjudication outcomes.
methodology.geocoding: Locations are estimated along the named frontage street using Chicago street-centerline address ranges and parity. Points represent street positions, not building centroids or exact vehicle positions. Unresolved locations remain in totals and time charts but are excluded from point maps. Conventional ticket locations are block estimates. Zone polygons were supplied by Alex Cannon.
methodology.timestamps: Issued Date values have no timezone offset in the source extract. The build treats them as Chicago local wall time and does not shift hours or weekdays.
methodology.zoneAssignment: Points are classified against the supplied Smart Streets zone polygons. A small number of decoded points fall just outside the supplied polygons and are retained.
methodology.wardAssignment: Ward attribution uses Chicago ward polygons and, when unambiguous, a 6-meter offset toward the address-range side of the street. The display point stays on the centerline. Attribution points within approximately 3 meters of a ward boundary, or unresolved locations, have Unknown Ward. Ward results are geographic estimates, not verified vehicle positions.
methodology.cameraDepartments: Camera IDs beginning with FI are grouped as Finance, IDs beginning with DT are grouped as Transportation, and IDs without those prefixes are grouped as CTA Bus.

pilotExpansion.note: First day with at least 50 violations inside the expansion zone and outside the initial pilot zone.
